js: (async () => { const G = window.G; if (!G.creative.on) G.toggleCreative(); for (const id of ['hotbar', 'mode']) { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.style.display = 'none'; } const p = G.player.pos; p.y = G.TH(p.x, p.z) + 55; G.player.vy = 0; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 4000)); return JSON.stringify({ y: +p.y.toFixed(1), boden: +G.TH(p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), kreativ: G.creative.on }); })()
